'''Lightning Squadron''' was a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served as a part of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Solo Fleet|task force]] during the hunt for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].

Lightning Squadron was stationed aboard the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] carrier ''[[Battle Dog]]'' and flew as a part of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' assault force during the attack on the Iron Fist in the [[Vahaba system/Legends|Vahaba system]]. Later, it formed part of the ''[[Mon Remonda/Legends|Mon Remonda]]''{{'s}} defensive screen during the [[Battle of Selaggis]] that followed. It was highly likely that the squadron suffered heavy losses when Zsinj's decoy, ''[[Second Death]]'', was detonated.
